description: React component 'ErrorViewer' which renders detailed error information, including traceback parsing and toggle functionalities.

methods.name: toggleFrame
methods.description: Toggles the expanded state of an individual traceback frame.

methods.name: toggleAllFrames
methods.description: Toggles all traceback frames between expanded and collapsed states.

methods.name: parseTraceback
